pluginDescription: Ships the OpenCode Go provider, a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header and the rolling / weekly / monthly usage

usage.error.noKey: The provider has no API key yet

usage.error.entitlement: This key has no OpenCode Go subscription
usage.error.network: The request failed or timed out

guide.title: Getting started
guide.tip: The plugin never changes SiYuan's configuration on its own: each step below runs only after you click it.
guide.warn: Use at your own risk: this plugin is not an official OpenCode client and is not on OpenCode's validated-client list. OpenCode states that Go is meant for OpenCode and for coding agents producing similar traffic, that it monitors for abuse, and that validated third-party clients are not guaranteed to keep working. Breaching its terms of service can get your access restricted or terminated, so do not use this to bypass usage limits.
guide.step1.title: 1. Create the OpenCode Go provider
guide.step1.desc: Click the button to create the provider in SiYuan's own AI settings page together with the required headers. An entry that already points at this endpoint is adopted instead, so nothing is ever duplicated.
guide.step1.done: The OpenCode Go provider is ready
guide.step1.failed: Creating the provider failed; turn on the debug log and check the console
guide.step2.title: 2. Fill in the credentials
guide.step2.desc: Click the button to open SiYuan's own AI settings page on this provider and paste the API key there. Add the models you need the same native way; the plugin never touches the model list.
guide.step3.title: 3. Check
guide.step3.desc: Click the button to check the provider, the headers, the API key, the model count, the session variable and the usage endpoint; the result shows up below.
guide.step3.done: Check finished, see the result below
settings.repairTip: Fills in missing required headers and endpoint fields and strips blanks/zero width characters from the API key; a deleted provider is rebuilt, and a single existing entry on the same endpoint is adopted instead of duplicated.
settings.repairDone: The provider config has been repaired
settings.headerStrategyTip: How x-opencode-session is filled: when on, every conversation sends its own stable ID, written before the request leaves. When off, the static ID below is used for everything.
settings.staticSessionIdTip: Used when per-conversation sending is off; leave empty to generate an installation level ID.
settings.userAgentModeTip: The official documentation asks clients to identify themselves instead of using a generic SDK name.
settings.customUserAgentTip: Only used when the previous item is set to custom.
settings.inlineUsageTip: Only shown while the OpenCode Go endpoint is in use; click it for the details.
settings.topBarButtonTip: Register a plugin button in the top bar that opens the usage dialog; off by default.
settings.usageDialogTip: Open the dialog at any time for the rolling / weekly / monthly usage, the current session ID and the endpoint error detail.
settings.intervalTip: 300 seconds by default, 30 - 3600 allowed; opening the settings page or the detail dialog refreshes once.
settings.debugLogTip: Print prefixed diagnostics to the developer console; it never contains the API key.
check.modelsEmpty: none yet (add them yourself on the provider page from step 2)
check.dismissed: deleted by hand (the plugin never rebuilds it on its own; use Create the provider above)
check.apiKeyDirty: holds blanks/zero width characters (chat will be rejected; Repair now strips them)
check.apiKeyNonAscii: character {index} is not ASCII (Repair now strips blanks and zero width characters, the rest has to be pasted again)
message.variableTip: The OPENCODE_GO_SESSION variable in your variable store is maintained by this plugin; please do not delete or rename it.
